title: The Third Plate

cards.text: Every night, Mum sets the table for three.
It has only ever been the two of us.
When I asked who the third plate was for, she said: "The one who stays quiet."
Last night, I didn't set it.
At 3am, I heard a chair scrape across the kitchen floor.
This morning, there was a note on my plate.

outro: Follow for a new story every night.
